question.text: The straight line through the origin which divides the area formed by the curves $y=2 x-x^{2}, y=0$ and $x=1$ into two equal halves is

solution.text: $y=2 x-x^{2}, y=0, x=1$ Area $=A=\int_{0}^{1}\left(2 x-x^{2}\right) d x$ or, $A=\frac{2}{3}$ sq units Let $y=m x$ line divides area in two equal halves $\therefore \frac{1}{2} \times 1 \times \mathrm{m}=\frac{1}{3}$ or, $\mathrm{m}=\frac{2}{3} \therefore$ equation of line is $\mathrm{y}=\frac{2}{3} \mathrm{x}$
